title: Moving a saved copy from 38.31, 38.28 and the 25.0 to 38.26 builds into the new shape: every saved field to its target, or listed
written_in: SCHEMA_V3 0, 2, 11 and 11.1; DECISIONS_ROUND2 E1, E6, H9, I5, J2, K3, O (and its watch items), X1, X9 and X watch; foundation_review/MOVE_FIELDS.md (the field list per build)
notes: Every amount is made up. Amounts in a saved copy are major units with up to two decimals (every build); the moved records hold whole minor units [section 0]; an amount with more decimals than its currency is rounded half up and flagged in `rounded` [Y23].

Question `move`: `copy` is the saved copy as an object, or `raw` the stored text itself (the move reads the raw text, never a cleaned copy [O]). `idb` is the IndexedDB second copy (`{ rev, t }`, `t` the moment of its save, a time or ms); `now` is the move's own moment, with the moving device's offset (X9), which is also `offset` unless given. The copy's last save is `idb.t`, else the stored `rev` when it is a time, else `now` [Y13]; its day is "the copy's last saved day" [H9, K3]. The move month is the calendar month of `now` [Y21]. `answers` holds the answers to the move's questions: `cur` (the currency code), `loanLine` (a plan.debts id, or `drop`), `pay` (`{ a, b, side }`: each a rule, SCHEMA_V3 5), `billDay` (by 38.31 line id, a rule), `goalMoney` (by goal id: `bank`, or `{ name, type }` for another account). `make.receipts` adds that many plain receipts to the copy (test help, so mv-35 can hold 5,002 receipts).

The answer is the moved copy: `v`, `home`, `people`, `accounts`, `places`, `schedules`, `events`, `plan` (`shares`, `budgets`, `limits`), `imports`, `ui` (the shared screen answers), `device` (`look`, `tour`, `opens`), `asks` (the move's questions, each answered one with its `answer`), `unplaced` (every saved field with no target, kept in frozen3831 or on the shared ui as 11.1 says, which the move test lists [11.1]), `held` (fields whose target waits for an answer: a one-month amount or a month-end answer until the pay or bill day is answered), `zero` (the move summary of lines and pay amounts that are 0 every month, not moved [Y25]), `rounded` [Y23], `sample`, `saved` (the copy's last save) and `frozen3831`. `show` picks parts (`plan.limits` picks one part of plan; `tally` counts the spends and adds them up; `ids` lists every record id); `omit` leaves a field out everywhere. Records carry `told` only on events; `at` and `by` are written by `move_two`.

Ids [X1, Y28, Z]: `mv:<kind>:<38.31 id, key or field path>` with the kinds of MOVE_FIELDS.md section 7: acct, card, debt, place, bill, line, pay, auto, item, share, person, open, check, rc. A month-end answer is the period-end record `pe:<occurrence>:free` [Y8].

The opening [B6, B7, 11.1]: the oldest bank figure (bankStart or bankNow; on the same day bankNow [Y22]) opens the bank with an `open` and a `check` on its day; a newer figure is a later `check`. A figure's day with no time is told at the end of that day, or at the copy's last save when that is earlier [Y1]. The opening day is that figure's day, else the copy's last saved day. Goal money kept in the bank is the open's `split` [B6]; the rest of the split (budget lines and Free to spend left, Waiting) is the opening's own question [B2, I4] and is not written by the move.

Question `move_two` [X1, Y12]: `phone` and `desktop` each hold a `move` input plus `by` (the device part). Each device moves its own copy and stamps every record with `told` (events keep their own), `at` (its `now`) and `by`; the two moved copies are merged with rules/merge_ref.js.

Sample data is never moved as real (requirements 1c): the sample shows while ui.done lacks pay, bills or goals, unless the copy is blank or cleared (every build's `sampleOn`). Receipts, cards and a typed bank figure are the person's and move as real [Y16].

The expected outputs of mv-01 to mv-45 were re-worked by hand from MOVE_FIELDS.md, SCHEMA_V3 11.1 and the decisions (Y and Z included), not taken from the reference; mv-46 to mv-67 were written by hand for Y and Z, and mv-68 and mv-69 for the coverage grid's move row (COVERAGE.md). Every open question below names what the reference does; no case depends on one.

cases.question: move
cases.title: The shape version becomes 3; the old `rev` is not carried
cases.why: The moved copy is `v: 3` [11.1 `v`, `rev`]; the old revision count 57 is not a field of the new copy (it stays only in `frozen3831`) and is not listed as unplaced, because 11.1 gives it a target (replaced). The new `rev` is shown in mv-41.

cases.question: move
cases.title: bankStart with its bankAt opens the bank on that day
cases.why: The only bank figure, 300,000 typed on Sun 22 Nov (`bankAt`), is the oldest, so it opens the bank: an `open` and a `check` the same day [11.1, B6, B7], on an account named "Bank" [Y26] that is the main bank [Y18]; the home currency starts that day [O6]. bankAt is a day with no time, so both are told at the end of Sun 22 Nov in the moving device's offset (+09:00), which is earlier than the copy's last save, Tue 24 Nov 08:00 [Y1, X9]. Ids: `mv:open:cfg`, `mv:check:cfg.bankStart` (a field path, Y28).

cases.question: move
cases.title: bankStart with no bankAt is dated to the copy's last saved day and told at the save
cases.why: No bankAt: the figure is dated to the last saved day, Tue 24 Nov [H9], and told at the copy's last save, 08:00 +09:00 [J2]. It is the only figure, so it opens the bank.

cases.question: move
cases.title: bankStart and a newer bankNow: the older opens, the newer is a later check
cases.why: bankStart 300,000 on Fri 20 Nov is the oldest figure, so it opens the bank; bankNow 296,000 on Mon 23 Nov is a check of its own on its day [11.1]. Each is told at the end of its own day (+09:00), both earlier than the save, Tue 24 Nov 08:00 [Y1].

cases.question: move
cases.title: bankNow with no bankNowAt is dated to the last saved day and told at the save
cases.why: No bankNowAt: dated Tue 24 Nov, the copy's last saved day [K3], told at the save [J2]. With no bankStart it is the oldest figure and opens the bank.

cases.question: move
cases.title: bankStart with its day and bankNow with none: the bankNow check is dated and told at the save
cases.why: bankStart 300,000 on 22 Nov opens the bank, told at the end of 22 Nov [Y1]; bankNow 294,000 has no day, so it is dated 24 Nov, the copy's last saved day [K3], told at the save [J2], and is the later check (as scenarios/moved_bank_now.json).

cases.question: move
cases.title: Receipts become spend events, told at the start of their day, with their line or place and their note
cases.why: Each receipt is a `spend` [6.3, 11.1]: r1's `bill:food` is the Food budget line, r2's `envelope` is Free to spend (a place), r3's `other` is Free to spend with line `other` [Y20]. The note moves unchanged: r1 "market", r3 "stamps", r2 has none [Y14]; `cn` is the category's name on screen and needs no place (the line or place names it). r3's `s` ("Cash jar") names no account; with the note unchanged it has no target, so it stays in `frozen3831` and is listed (open: see move.json `open`). Each receipt is told at the start of its day (+09:00) [Y1, J2, X9].

cases.question: move
cases.title: A receipt whose `s` names an imported account is on that account
cases.why: `s` "GCash" names the account the statement import made (ui.accts), so the spend's `acct` is that account [11.1]; the imported account keeps its name [Y18]. `other` is Free to spend with line `other` [Y20]; the note "load" moves unchanged [Y14].

cases.question: move
cases.title: A typed minimum becomes home.minBank
cases.why: cfg.minBank 50,000 was typed (no ui.minAuto), so it is `home.minBank` with its currency [11.1, O6]. No bank figure: no main bank.

cases.question: move
cases.title: A minimum the app filled in itself is dropped
cases.why: cfg.minBank equals ui.minAuto, so the app set it (a tenth of the pay), nobody chose it: dropped, `home.minBank` is null [11.1, MAKO M1]. ui.minAuto itself goes nowhere and is not listed.

cases.question: move
cases.title: ceiling and aims become plan.limits; planFrom is not moved
cases.why: cfg.ceiling and cfg.aims are `plan.limits` with its currency [11.1, O6]; aims are shares, not amounts, so they are not converted. cfg.planFrom is not needed (periods come from pay) and stays in `frozen3831` only, so it is not listed [11.1].

cases.question: move
cases.title: Each kind of line goes to its home: bills, budget lines and shares
cases.why: rent is a bill schedule paid from the main bank, its `def` the first step from the opening (24 Nov), and the move asks its due day [11.1]. food, card and the custom lines are budget lines with the place from their jar (nec: bills, edu: edu, play: free) [11.1, B8]. spend and learn are plan.shares (`free`, `edu`) from the opening [11.1].

cases.question: move
cases.title: A line's redirect points to the Emergency fund
cases.why: In every build a line's `redirect` sends its money to the Emergency fund after its last month, so `redirect` names that place [11.1]. `ends` "2027-03" becomes the last day of that month, Wed 31 Mar 2027 [Y6].

cases.question: move
cases.title: A goal becomes a place with its plain fields, unknown plain fields kept
cases.why: plan.goals becomes `places` [11.1]: kind goal (ui.gk "moving" is a goal kind), target, due, slot and why kept, kept in the main bank (the default, DECISIONS 23 Nov), currency on the place. The unknown plain field `color` is kept on the place [11.1, section 0].

cases.question: move
cases.title: Goal money is part of the bank's opening split and the move asks where it is; a pay-off goal is never opened as savings
cases.why: trip's start, 30,000, is asked about (in the bank or another account) [Y17]; until answered it is treated as kept in the bank [Z3], so it is part of the bank's 200,000 opening split [11.1, B6]. owe is a pay-off goal (ui.gk "debt"): no debt has its name, so it pays a new loan account named like it, whose balance and payment day are asked [Y11, Y9]; its 10,000 "saved so far" was paid, so it is never opened as savings and is kept on that loan as `paidBefore` [Z6].

cases.question: move
cases.title: ui.gk "debt" makes a pay-off place
cases.why: ui.gk "debt" is the pay-off kind: `kind: payoff`, no `keptIn` (it is not savings) [11.1], and `pays` is the new loan account named like it, as no debt has its name [Y11].

cases.question: move
cases.title: The Emergency fund keeps its stretch, stretchOn and stretchFrom
cases.why: The emergency goal is a place of kind emergency with `stretch`, `stretchOn` and `stretchFrom` as they are [11.1].

cases.question: move
cases.title: Older copies with no plan: the four sample goals take the cfg goal figures
cases.why: A copy with no plan is read the way every build reads it: the sample's four goals with the older cfg figures on top. moveTarget and moveMonth give the move goal 20,000 due 1 Sep 2027; travelTarget the trip 9,000; carDue the yearly cost's day (its target stays the sample's 3,500); rainyTarget and rainyStretch the Emergency fund [11.1]. None of them is listed as unplaced.

cases.question: move
cases.title: plan.debts become loan and card accounts opened at their balance; debt: steps become extraSteps
cases.why: Each debt is an account opened at its balance on the opening day (24 Nov), told at the save [11.1, I5]: the loan with `apr` 3.5, `minRule: { fixed: 20,000 }`, `extraSteps` 2,000 from the opening (its `extra`) and 5,000 from 1 Feb 2027 (its `debt:car` step, from that month's first day [Y3]); the card the same way, with close day "not sure" (`cutDay: null`) and `inFull: false` [Y9]. Each payment day is asked [Y9].

cases.question: move
cases.title: Spending that logs itself: weekly on its weekday, monthly on its day
cases.why: gym: every week on `on` 1 (Monday); its `from`, Wed 18 Nov, moves to the first Monday on or after it, Mon 23 Nov, which is the rule's start [11.1, H9]; `last` 23 Nov is the last day already logged; its `other` category is Free to spend with line `other`, as a receipt's is (Y20; the spends it logs are receipts). veg: monthly on the 15th from 20 Nov, on the Food budget line (`c` bill:food). Both are autoSpend schedules paid from the main bank [11.1, 5].

cases.question: move
cases.title: cards[] become pay-in-full card accounts opened with what is owed on their day
cases.why: The card is a `card` account with payDay 27, `cutDay: null` (not sure) and `inFull: true`, paid from the main bank, opened with a check of 45,000 dated its `at`, Fri 20 Nov, told at the end of that day [11.1, Y1]. The receipt's `s` names the card, so the spend is on it; `other` is Free to spend with line `other` [Y20]; its note "books" unchanged [Y14].

cases.question: move
cases.title: A copy with no currency is asked before anything is moved
cases.why: The raw text has no ui.cur: no currency was ever chosen, so the move asks, never pesos [O, H9], and converts nothing until it is answered [11.1].

cases.question: move
cases.title: ₱ with preset legacy is asked
cases.why: 38.28's clean-up writes ₱ and `legacy` into a copy with no currency, so this ₱ is not a choice: asked [O, units-63].

cases.question: move
cases.title: ₱ with preset legacy, answered pesos: amounts become centavos
cases.why: Answered PHP: 2 decimals, so 15,000.50 is 1,500,050 and 120.25 is 12,025 in minor units [section 0, L units q1]; the answered question is recorded. The receipt's note is empty, so it has none [Y14]; `other` is Free to spend with line `other` [Y20].

cases.question: move
cases.title: ₱ with the peso sample chosen is pesos, nothing asked
cases.why: The copy holds ₱ and was set up from the peso sample, so pesos were chosen [O, units-65]: PHP, 8,000.00 is 800,000.

cases.question: move
cases.title: Fields with no row are kept where 11.1 says and listed
cases.why: Any field not listed in 11.1 is kept: on the shared ui if it was under ui (hope, newKey, and loanMode, loanTotal and subsX, which every build deletes on load but a raw text may still hold), else in `frozen3831` (the top-level zz, cfg.zq, the receipt's t), and the move lists every one [11.1].

cases.question: move
cases.title: ui keys: shared screen answers, device look and tour, opens, name
cases.why: name is `people[0].name`, id `mv:person:ui.name` [Y28]. The calculator inputs (loans, subP, subO, subs, cardT, cardB) and the screen answers (done, limits, noDebts, askNums, win, sb, bd, more, setup, cleared, src, full, home, mcOk) and main are shared ui as they are. The tour keys (tourAt, toured, onb) and the coach-mark key (`seen`, the tabs whose coach marks were shown) are the device's `tour`; the look, sound and reminder keys its `look` [Y15, D3]; wk is the device's `opens` [E9]. The Undo copies keep, keeps and preSplit are not moved [D2].

cases.question: move
cases.title: ui.accts become accounts and ui.cats becomes imports.cats
cases.why: ui.accts are accounts with their names and types, confirmed at the first check-in; ui.cats is `imports.cats` [11.1].

cases.question: move
cases.title: Pay amounts move to pay streams; a stream that is 0 every month is not moved; the move asks when each pay comes in (Y2)
cases.why: steps.a is the main pay stream: an income schedule that starts periods, named as 38.31 names it ("Salary"), into the main bank, 250,000 in force at the opening, so its first step is from the opening, Tue 24 Nov [Y2, Y3]. The move asks when it comes in; until then it has no rule (no future pay is counted, section 11). steps.b is 0 every month, so it is not moved and is listed in the move summary (`zero`), as a line that is 0 every month is [Y25].

cases.question: move
cases.title: Steps of a bill, a budget line and a share: the amount in force at the opening, then from each later month's first day (Y3, Y7)
cases.why: The opening is 24 Nov. Rent: 80,000 is in force in November (its step overrides the def 70,000), so it is the first step from 24 Nov; 82,000 from 1 Apr 2027, the first day of that month [Y7, Y3]. Food the same: 40,000, then 45,000 from 1 Feb 2027 [Y3]. Free to spend: the def 15,000 in November, then 18,000 from 1 Dec 2026, each a plan.shares entry [Y3]; steps before the opening are not entries of their own (only the one in force at the opening carries) [Y3].

cases.question: move
cases.title: goal: steps and a goal's monthly become plan.shares goals; a dated goal's set-aside is worked out as 38.31 did, from the move day (Y10)
cases.why: trip has no date and a monthly 5,000: the share from the opening holds 5,000 for it; its step makes 6,000 from 1 Jan 2027 [11.1, Y3]. car has a date: its monthly set-aside is what 38.31 works out each month (evenSave) and becomes its share amount from the move day, Tue 24 Nov, which is the opening day [Y10]: (60,000 target - 0 saved) / 7 months (Nov 2026, the plan's first month, to May 2027, its last saving month: due 15 Jun, and the 15th is not after 38.31's day 15) = 8,571.43, rounded up to 38.31's unit of 5 (no pay in the copy) = 8,575. It stays 8,575 in the January entry.

cases.question: move
cases.title: Stale steps keys are listed
cases.why: line:gone1 belongs to no line, goal or debt (its line was removed in an older build): it has no target, stays in `frozen3831` and is listed [11.1].

cases.question: move
cases.title: once[ym]: a budget line's goes to the first period starting that month, pay and bill ones to that month's occurrence; the rest have no target (Y2, Y7)
cases.why: The pay is answered monthly on the 25th, so the first period starting in January starts with the pay due Mon 25 Jan 2027: the Food line's 50,000 is its `once` for that occurrence [11.1, T1, units-78]. a's 1,000 is that month's pay: `amounts` on the 25 Jan occurrence [Y2]. Rent is answered due on the 27th: its 0 for January is `amounts` on 27 Jan [Y7]. side has only a one-month amount, so it is a stream (0 from the opening) whose day is not answered yet: its January amount waits for that answer (`held`). draw, envelope (a share), goal:trip and debt:car have no one-period target, so each is listed.

cases.question: move
cases.title: items[ym]: due on the month's first day; in the opening month, the first day after the opening
cases.why: The opening is Tue 24 Nov. November's gift would be due 1 Nov, before the opening, so it is due Wed 25 Nov, the first day after it, never treated as paid [H9, 11.1]. April's car tax is due 1 Apr 2027. Each is a `once` schedule. December's empty list ("no one-time costs") moves nothing.

cases.question: move
cases.title: Receipts beyond 5,000 are all moved
cases.why: Every build's clean-up keeps only the first 5,000 receipts; the move reads the raw text [O], so all 5,002 are spend events: 5,002 x 100 = 500,200.

cases.question: move
cases.title: Month-end answers for months before the opening stay in frozen3831 only
cases.why: The opening is 2 Dec (bankAt); November's answer is for a period that ended before it, so it stays in `frozen3831` and is neither moved nor listed [11.1, P2].

cases.question: move
cases.title: The sample still shown is never moved as real
cases.why: Bills and goals are not done yet, so the app still shows the sample (every build's rule): its lines, goals, minimum and ceiling are sample data and are never moved as real [requirements 1c, 11.1]. The currency still starts the home currency. The copy has no receipt, card or bank figure (those move as real even while the sample shows, Y16: mv-59).

cases.question: move
cases.title: The loan line, not answered: asked, and written nowhere
cases.why: The move asks which loan the "Loan or debt payment" line is [11.1, E6]; until then it is neither a bill nor a budget line, so it is never counted twice [E6]. The copy has no bank figure, so the first check-in asks for one [Y19]; the debt's payment day is asked [Y9].

cases.question: move
cases.title: The loan line matched to a loan: one home, the loan account
cases.why: Answered "car": the line is matched to the car loan account [E6] and is not also a bill or a budget line. Its amount, 20,000, becomes the loan's fixed `minRule` and its steps the loan's payment steps, from the opening [Y4]; the line has no `ends` or `redirect`. The answer is recorded with the question (section 6 of MOVE_FIELDS: every question is recorded with its answer). No bank figure: `payFrom` is none until one is typed [Y19].

cases.question: move
cases.title: The loan line dropped with the person's OK
cases.why: Dropped with the person's OK [E6]: nothing is written for it and it is not listed; the answer is recorded with the question.

cases.question: move_two
cases.title: The move run on a phone and a desktop: built ids make one copy of each record
cases.why: Each device moves its own copy. Moved records have built ids `mv:<kind>:<38.31 id or key>` [X1, Y28], so after the merge there is one bank, one opening, one check and one r1, plus r2 from the phone and r3 from the desktop [D4]; `other` receipts are Free to spend with line `other` [Y20], and no note (their `n` is empty) [Y14]. The merged `rev` is the larger of both plus one: the desktop's 10:00 move, 2026-11-24T01:00Z, is 20,781 days x 86,400,000 + 3,600,000 = 1,795,482,000,000 ms, so 1,795,482,000,001 [L merge q3].

cases.question: move_two
cases.title: The same receipt different on two devices: the later move wins
cases.why: r1 was changed to 1,200 on the phone and is still 1,000 on the desktop. Two devices' moves merge like any records: the newer `at` wins per record [Y12, D4]; each moved record's `at` is its device's move moment, and the desktop moved later (10:00), so r1 is 1,000 on both. Its note is empty, so it has none [Y14].

cases.question: move
cases.title: Older copies with no plan: the sample plan with the cfg figures; its empty loan and card lines are not moved, and loanLast and redirectLoan go with the loan line (Y4, Y5, Y25)
cases.why: With no plan, every build reads the sample plan with the cfg figures on top, cfg.loanLast and cfg.redirectLoan on the "Loan or debt payment" line [Y5]. That line and "Other card spending" are 0 every month (the sample has 0 for both and the copy no step), so neither is moved and both are listed in the move summary [Y4: empty lines are dropped, Y25]; loanLast and redirectLoan, which belong to the loan, are listed with it. So no loan question is asked. The six sample bills are asked their days, and the Emergency fund's 25,000 (the sample's start) where it is [Y17].

cases.question: move
cases.title: A copy saved by 25.0 to 31.0 moves by the same rules
cases.why: The oldest builds save the same fields less the later ones (no receipt `s`, no ui.sweep, no debts, recurring or cards, whole goal amounts; MOVE_FIELDS.md), so the same rules apply: the 150,000 bankStart with no day opens the bank on the last saved day with the Emergency fund's 40,000 in its split [H9, B6]; the typed minimum is home.minBank; Food 30,000 (its step) is a budget line; "Play money" (the old name of Free to spend) is the `free` share, 12,000, with the fund's monthly 5,000; the cinema receipt is in Free to spend, its note "cinema" unchanged [Y14]. The fund has money, so the move asks where it is [Y17].

cases.question: move
cases.title: frozen3831 is the raw stored text, exactly
cases.why: The whole copy is kept as the raw text it was stored as, spaces and all, never a cleaned copy [O, 11.1].

cases.title: Y2: the three pay amounts become three income streams; only the salary starts periods; a month's pay is `amounts` on that month's occurrence
cases.question: move
cases.why: a: 240,000 (the October step) is in force at the opening, Tue 24 Nov, so it is the first step; 260,000 from 1 Apr 2027 [Y2, Y3]; answered monthly on the 25th, the rule is from the opening; January's 300,000 is `amounts` on the 25 Jan occurrence; October's once is before the opening and stays in frozen3831 only. b is a second stream and side a third, neither starting periods [Y2, F12]: b 30,000 from the opening; side has no step in force at the opening (0) and 15,000 from 1 Dec [Y3]. The days of b and side are asked.

cases.title: Y1: a figure typed on the copy's last saved day is told at the save, which is earlier than the end of that day
cases.question: move
cases.why: bankNowAt is Tue 24 Nov, the day of the copy's last save. The end of that day (23:59:59.999 +09:00) is later than the save (08:00), so the figure is told at the save [Y1].

cases.title: Y22: bankStart and bankNow on the same day: bankNow wins
cases.question: move
cases.why: Both figures are dated Sun 22 Nov, so bankNow, 290,000, wins [Y22]: it opens the bank and is its one check, told at the end of 22 Nov [Y1]. bankStart stays in frozen3831 (decided, so not listed).

cases.title: Y4: a loan line with no debt to match becomes a loan account whose balance is asked
cases.question: move
cases.why: The copy has no debt to match the line to, so the line becomes a loan account named like it, whose balance is asked [Y4]; its payment day is asked [Y9]. Its 15,000 is the fixed `minRule`, its steps the payment steps (15,000 from the opening, 18,000 from 1 Mar 2027) [Y4, Y3], its last month Sep 2027 the loan's `ends`, 30 Sep 2027 [Y6], and its redirect the loan's redirect to the Emergency fund at its end [Y4]. It is never also a bill or a budget line [E6].

cases.title: Y4, Y5: the loan line matched to a debt; with a plan, cfg.loanLast and redirectLoan go to that loan when the line has none
cases.question: move
cases.why: Matched to the car loan: the line's 20,000 becomes its fixed `minRule` (in place of the debt's own 18,000) and its payment steps [Y4]. The line has no `ends` or `redirect` of its own, so cfg.loanLast (Jun 2027, last day 30 Jun) and redirectLoan go to that loan's `ends` and `redirect` [Y5, Y6]; they are placed, so not listed.

cases.title: Y5: with a plan, the older goal figures are used only for a goal id the plan does not have
cases.question: move
cases.why: The plan has a goal `rainy`, so cfg.rainyTarget is not used: its 600,000 stands. The plan has no goal `travel`, so cfg.travelTarget is used: the sample trip goal (every build's GOAL_DEFS) with target 9,000 [Y5]. Both figures are placed by Y5, so neither is listed.

cases.title: Y8: month-end answers after the opening become pe: records; bank moves to Waiting, next keeps, hide writes nothing
cases.question: move
cases.why: The opening is Sat 24 Oct; every answer here is for a month ending on or after it [P2]. The pay is monthly on the 25th, so the period starting in December starts with the pay due 25 Dec and ends the day before the next, Sun 24 Jan 2027: December's "bank" answer is `pe:mv:pay:steps.a@2026-12-25:free`, moving 3,000 to Waiting [Y8, T1], told at its own time (`t`, 2 Jan 2027 10:00 +09:00). January's "next" keeps 2,000 in Free to spend (a move to the place itself) for the period from 25 Jan to 24 Feb, told at the copy's last save (no `t`). October's `hide` writes nothing [Y8]. November's answer is the older shape `{ amt, id }` (money put toward a goal), which Y8 does not name: listed (open).

cases.why: The opening is Sat 10 Oct (bankAt); the move runs Tue 24 Nov. Free to spend is 10,000 from the opening. The dated goal's monthly set-aside, worked out as 38.31 does, (60,000 - 0) / 7 months (Nov 2026 to May 2027) = 8,571.43, rounded up to 5 = 8,575, is its share from the move day [Y10], so a second entry starts that day with every amount in force then.

Its 10,000 "saved so far" was paid to Ken, so it is never opened as savings: no split, no ask; it is kept on the loan as `paidBefore`, a note of what was paid before the move [Z6]. cases.title: Y13: no second copy: the stored rev is the last save when it is a time
cases.question: move
cases.why: No IndexedDB second copy. 38.31 saves `rev` as max(now, rev + 1), so 1,795,474,800,000 is a time: 20,781 days x 86,400,000 = 1,795,478,400,000 ms is 24 Nov 2026 00:00 UTC, less 3,600,000 is 23 Nov 23:00 UTC, which is Tue 24 Nov 08:00 +09:00. That is the last save [Y13]: the figure is dated that day and told then.

open.question: Y8 names the 38.31 answers `to: 'bank'`, `to: 'next'` and `hide`. 38.28 and older builds (and 38.31 for a goal top-up) save `{ amt, id }`: that month's Free to spend put toward goal `id`. Is it a move to that goal's place in the pe: record?

Y2 and Y8 speak of "that month's occurrence" and "the period starting in that month". For pay weekly, every two weeks or twice a month, several occurrences and periods fall in one month, and 38.31's amount is a monthly total ("if you get paid twice a month add both"). Which occurrence takes a one-month amount, which period takes a month-end answer, and what is each pay's amount?
open.ref_does: Models only an answer of monthly on one day; with any other rule the one-month amounts and month-end answers are held.

open.question: Until the pay day (or a bill's day) is answered there is no occurrence: a one-month pay or bill amount (Y2, Y7), a budget line's one-month amount (11.1) and a month-end answer (Y8) have no key yet. Kept waiting, and shown how?
